about: Raderna i "Blades was updated"-popupen: en post per EAS Update, nyast först, id +1 varje gång. Bara den uppdateringens egna ändringar, på engelska, med New:, Improved: eller Fixed: som App Store-texten och det viktigaste först. Se services/updateNotes.ts och scripts/publish-update.mjs.

notes: New: Next licence has a new look. See how ready you are, which requirement sets the date and every licence you've completed, as a chart or a list.
Improved: Experience & projections is now simply called Projections.
New: Experience & projections has a new look. Drag your target on the chart, try another pace and follow your goals.
New: Custom CSV export for your drone logbook, and drone CSV import now works like the pilot import.
Fixed: Sharing an export no longer risks freezing the app.
Fixed: Scanning never accepts a time that doesn't exist, like 07:80, and suggests real times instead.
Fixed: The maps no longer stop responding after you open an airport's weather.
Fixed: The globe on the dashboard comes back by itself if it stops moving.
Improved: This message now only shows what's new since your last update.
